receipt.reasoning_quality: partly contradicted: it says the dashboard uses the same stock-balance test as inventory overview, but it omits Direction

review.summary: Dashboard sums positive QuantityMilliUnits without Direction. InventoryRules and GetInventoryOverviewAsync add In and subtract Out. RecordWasteHandler stores validated positive quantity with Direction=Out. Thus 10,000 In plus 2,000 Out yields dashboard 12,000 but inventory balance 8,000. Existing vertical slice test expects 8,000 after those directions; inspected, not executed. This is the existing FIN-013 defect, not a new finding.
review.root_cause: Owner dashboard aggregate ignores signed movement direction.
review.impact: The dashboard can suppress low-stock alerts when actual signed stock is at or below the configured minimum. No cash-loss or valuation claim.
review.counterevidence: Existing FIN-013 covers the same root and fix. Existing test proves inventory overview expectation but does not exercise dashboard parity.
review.recommendation: Keep FIN-013 canonical; calculate dashboard balance with the same signed direction rule as inventory overview. Verify low-stock behavior across Out movement types.
tests: Compare dashboard and inventory balances after positive-quantity Out count adjustment and waste.
Set minimum between unsigned and signed totals and assert both views agree on low-stock state.
Cover waste, spoilage, breakage, usage and count-adjustment Out.
